paragraphs.source_en: The Telemanuses wait for me in the hall. Kavax takes me into a hug that cracks my back. Daxo nods his head. I’m left feeling dazed between the two of them. It is the first time I’ve spoken to either without violence afoot. Truth be told, I’ve avoided them for shame of what I let happen to Pax.

paragraphs.source_en: Kavax scoops up his fox. It licks his neck and peers fiercely at me before it nuzzles into his thick red beard.
